whenToUse: People need to know who replied to whom.
There are enough comments that some should be folded.
whenNotToUse: Discussions where replies to replies run deep (use a flat list with quotes).
accessibility: Each comment is an article named after its author.
The view replies and reply buttons have aria-expanded.
When the reply input opens, it takes focus.
Replies are set apart with a line as well as indentation.
